newsitem.title: UK: Big investors press United chairman to go - FT.
newsitem.headline: Big investors press United chairman to go - FT.

text.p: Major institutional investors in United Utilities Plc are pressing for Sir Desmond Pitcher to step down as executive chairman, said a report in the Financial Times on Friday.

The report said the shareholders have told Sir Peter Middleton, non-executive director of the company, that the group should put in place a succession plan which would involve Pitcher moving to non-executive chairman this year.
Eight shareholders are said to be involved and they wish to have Pitcher leave the board by 2000.

The FT report quotes one unidentified shareholder saying: "I have never known my colleagues in the shareholding world so worked up about anything before. There is a danger that the board is split from top to bottom, left to right."
